name: Toraware Hime ~Sei Megami Dorei Choukyou~
original_name: 囚われ姫 ～聖女神奴隷調教～
source:
In a time where continental unification is within grasp of the sacred Toulle Empire, a band of rebels rise up against the military state. Shouldering the movement are the elven princess Arise and war goddess Maldol. Their beauty and powerful influence cannot be ignored.

And this elite magical force stands face to face with the Empire. But Commander Adolf who is also the prince uses atrocious trickery, and soon defeats Arise and Maldol. To punish them for their treachery, he takes away their magical powers, and makes them his very own.

Arise and Maldol are now imprisoned and helpless to resist the days of cruel training that shall now begin...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061348.html]DLsite English[/url]]
